reviews.author: Joe couri
reviews.text: Clean and great location however the staff needs to learn basic customer service, very pricey for what it is.

reviews.author: Eduardo Luzania
reviews.text: Nice place

reviews.author: Tilvert Anderson
reviews.text: This was by far the best vacation I've had. The hotel was definitely a 10 out of 10. Great everything!!! I'll recommend anyone traveling to stay here.

reviews.author: James Burress
reviews.text: Pretty dam nice....

reviews.author: Tim Soboleski
reviews.text: This casino hotel is under renovation & has been over my last 4 visits. Remarkable improvement.

reviews.author: Tajana Hartwell
reviews.text: Great experience at this hotel. I called before I came because I needed to check in early. And I was able too. I let them know I was surprising my boyfriend for his birthday and they went out of their way and brought him some treats and a sweet card! Only thing I didn’t like was the parking but you get a choice to do self parking in the parking garage(which is shared with the mall) or valet. Overall experience was AMAZING!

reviews.author: Avi Siso
reviews.text: Very disappointing experience. I was charged on my credit card for items I did NOT take from the room and instead of properly checking the situation the hotel kept arguing with me and insisting I took them. The manager was also very unprofessional and not friendly at all which made the entire situation even worse. On top of that nobody answers the phone at the hotel which makes the whole situation even more frustrating. Instead of helping resolve the issue respectfully I felt accused and ignored. This is completely unacceptable customer service. Be very careful checking your final bill and credit card charges if you stay here. I will definitely not return.

reviews.author: Rachel Mordechai
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with this hotel and the way they treated my friend during what was supposed to be a special birthday trip.

I gave her this stay as a birthday gift, and I feel terrible about the experience she had. The hotel charged her for a bottle that she never drank, and when we tried to resolve the issue, we were treated with disrespect and accused of lying. The staff member I spoke with on the phone refused to provide her name and repeatedly insisted that my friend and I were being dishonest while automatically taking the side of housekeeping without properly investigating the situation.

What is even more concerning is that hotel staff entered my friend’s room while she was asleep without her permission. This was a serious invasion of privacy and made her feel unsafe.

Instead of listening to our concerns and handling the matter professionally, the hotel was dismissive, rude, and unwilling to take responsibility. Guests deserve to be treated with respect and have their privacy protected. Unfortunately, this experience fell far below those basic expectations.

I would not recommend this hotel based on how this situation was handled.

reviews.author: Moti Menachem
reviews.text: Excellent

reviews.author: Dan Hurlbert
reviews.text: Fun, upscale place in yhe heart of Scottsdale.

reviews.author: Tali Siso
reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience at Hilton Scottsdale.

My husband and I came to the hotel as part of a birthday gift, and what was supposed to be a relaxing and special stay turned into a frustrating and unprofessional experience.

During check-in, the front desk employee could not explain the charges and credits connected to our room, including a $200 restaurant credit gifted to us by friends. We were told a manager would call us back because management was “in a meeting.” Nobody ever followed up.

Later, I discovered a $434.70 charge on my bank account. When I called to ask about it, I was told we had opened a minibar drink in the room. This is completely false. Neither my husband nor I touched the minibar at all.

I tried calling multiple times to resolve the issue, but nobody was able to give me clear answers, and getting someone on the phone at the hotel was almost impossible. Calls were not being answered, and the entire situation was handled very poorly.

Charging guests without proof and failing to provide proper customer service is unacceptable.

Very disappointing ending to what was supposed to be a birthday celebration. We will not be returning or recommending this hotel.

reviews.author: Andrew
reviews.text: Great place, nice rooms clean, and fancy!

reviews.author: Kaydence Marrogy
reviews.text: Had such a great stay at Caesars Republic Scottsdale. The hotel was absolutely beautiful and everything was spotless the entire time we were there. Jasmine was incredible, she consistently checked in on us and went out of her way to make sure our stay was perfect. Her hospitality really made the experience stand out.

reviews.author: Bonner K
reviews.text: One of the very definitions of a luxury hotel is having great quality towels in your room that are a pleasure to dry off with after a shower. The towels provided in our room felt like sandpaper. They truly are scratchy and hard. I had trouble toweling off completely because it was such an unpleasant experience. The front desk told me that their towels are fine. Another definition of a luxury hotel is listening when a guest has an issue. The location is great. Maybe bring your own decent towels if you stay here.

reviews.author: Mohamed El-Sharkawy
reviews.text: Limited parking lot

reviews.author: Austin P
reviews.text: Solid hotel with friendly staff.

reviews.author: Bonnie Hui
reviews.text: Overall a well located hotel near shopping and other attractions, attentive service and nice facilities including a beautiful pool on the 8th floor terrace. Comfortable, clean and cool, modern decor in the hotel public areas and in the rooms.

reviews.author: Krystal Walters
reviews.text: The hotel receptionist Jasmine made sure our stay was comfortable and pleasant. She did an outstanding job with providing great hospitality to me and my son. Our experience was amazing!! We will definitely come back to this hotel!!

reviews.author: Andrea Smith
reviews.text: Everyone here was amazing! Mia the bar tender is amazing!

reviews.author: Adam Clark
reviews.text: Great hotel. Super nice, clean, service is great and food and amenities are awesome. Also a great location right in heart of Scottsdale. Will be back.

reviews.author: Michael Polito
reviews.text:
Decided to plan my wife and i's 5 year anniversary staycation local here in Scottsdale. I heard good things about this Hotel and since I'm a Hilton Gold member I thought.. why not?

1. We were promised late check out at 2pm for my status but the next morning I was woken up by a maid walking into my room after .5 seconds of waiting.

2. My room key was deactivated sometime during the morning hours while I was at the pool, so I had to find a way to the lobby (took 10 minutes) while I was wet and shirtless to regain access into my room.

3. The pool was FULL of bugs, I mean full.... so we decided to not even swim.

4. (The worst one) the wink water coming from the faucet smells like moldy, sewer water. The shower was amazing, but we decided to not use the tap water and instead utilized the free bottles of water for face washing and brushing our teeth. We explained this to the front desk lady and she seemed to not care.

Overall, the hotel seems to look a lot better on paper. I was definitely disappointed staying here and I don't see myself recommending it. Although, I will say the breakfast was amazing!!

reviews.author: Jennifer Bell
reviews.text: Went to Wolf inside the hotel. Food was good cocktails were delicious and our server was sweet and attentive.  The decor is over the top gorgeous!  A complete eyegasm.  Absolutely loved it for that alone.

reviews.author: ManolisandGenevieve Barlas
reviews.text: Honestly a total surprise the hotel was fantastic as well as the location and restaurants and outstanding service, especially Blake at the valet desk! Will DEFINITELY be back!

reviews.author: Trevor Johnson
reviews.text: Valet was world class top job by them

reviews.author: Christopher Hilliard
reviews.text:
I’ve been staying at Caesars Republic Scottsdale every weekend this March, and I can honestly say it’s become one of my favorite places to be.

From the moment you walk in, Jasmine at the front desk sets the tone. She is incredibly kind, welcoming, and genuinely helpful every single time. You can tell she truly cares about the guest experience, and she goes out of her way to make sure everything is perfect.

Blake in valet has also been amazing. Not only is he always professional and friendly, but he’s gone above and beyond by driving me around Scottsdale to different restaurants. That level of service is rare, and it definitely doesn’t go unnoticed.

And Luna has been a highlight of every stay. Kaitlyn and Sarah consistently provide top-tier service — they’re attentive, friendly, and make you feel like more than just a guest. They create such a welcoming atmosphere that keeps me coming back.

It’s the people here that make this hotel special. The service is truly exceptional across the board, and after spending so many weekends here, it feels like a home away from home. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Leslie J Stone
reviews.text: Very clean, easy to get to and courteous service

reviews.author: John B
reviews.text: The hotel decor and ambiance was amazing. Wolf the restaurant was also amazing. The room we stayed in was perfect for her birthday weekend. The only thing that made a stain on the entire stay was the front desk staff. Not very accomdating and very disimissive on multiple occasions. The rest of the staff in the hotel were fine, but the front desk staff left something to be desired. And you would figure this would be your most polished service besides the valet, since its one of the first places you come to upon arrival. The rating of 4 was because of the front desk staff experience. Other than that, it was an amazing stay in a beautiful and well designed hotel. Very upbeat and upscale vibe while very quiet in the room areas.

reviews.author: Michelle Hilliard
reviews.text: Hotel personnel go above and beyond at every turn. Blake in valet is amazing. He was always available to take us to wherever we needed to go. His personality was awesome and so kind. He is a great ambassador for the hotel.

reviews.author: Mary Mardos
reviews.text: Went for lunch with friends, the decor is very nice. The food was delicious, however took an extremely long time to come out. Our server Coco was very sweet, professional, and a delight.

reviews.author: Thump Dog
reviews.text: Cool spot.  Great location

reviews.author: Meredith Lowry
reviews.text:
My experience started with the valet staff, who are so professional, quick, and friendly.

The room is gorgeous and I got the best sleep with the blackout curtains.

Rooftop pool is beautiful with a view of the mountains, great service, food and drinks. I will definitely be returning.

reviews.author: Kes
reviews.text: We didn’t have the best service experience, luckily Jed the manager was able to step in where some other staff members fell short. Turned this from a 3 start to a 4 star experience. They have a staffing issue, and the black out blinds were installed incorrectly in our first room, the living area was black out and our bedroom was not, strange that nobody would pick up on this. Theres a sewage smell from the water, pretty intense. The restaurant staff were good, just be aware the hotel is often full for non guest events and the weekends can be busy with locals. The location is perfect, although the parking situation is horrible.

reviews.author: Chris Laney Photography
reviews.text:
Update: Management reaching out was very nice and appreciated. He was kind enough to call back and made sure we weren't left feeling like nobody cared. Thank you again for connecting the human element to this stay.

Was super excited for this one.. but unfortunately was let down. The check in process was a nightmare, cutting into our quality time, and left a bad taste in our mouths on Valentine's day.
Not sure what went wrong with preparations and timing but this stay did not meet our expectations and what we were hoping would be a redeeming Hilton experience turned out to be the opposite.
1 star each for friendly staff by the pool/housekeeping and the nice rooms. Misses out on 3 stars due to our room taking hours to be ready, terrible check in process that left us questioning if we had a place for the night and the room itself was not the expected room that was booked on Expedia.
Super disappointed by the overall lack of care shown in this stay. Hopefully management will continue making positive changes.

reviews.author: Carla Houle
reviews.text: Really loved the interior design of the room and hotel,  the only thing keeping it from being a truly 5 star experience was the thin windows in our room. We heard every car that pulled up to the hotel, and Ive never been in a place where there were so many super cars revving their engines as they either pulled up or cruised by but we heard every single one of them. Also sounded like the live music or dj was camped right outside of our door. We were in town for business and it was nit conducive to getting actual sleep.

reviews.author: Jeff Pupillo
reviews.text: Great hotel, great locationg

reviews.author: trev frazier
reviews.text: Beautiful

reviews.author: Matt
reviews.text: Great hotel but disappointed in service. They could not extend my checkout time by even 1 hour. This is why I prefer Marriotts and Hyatts.

reviews.author: Jeremy “ACE” Lewis
reviews.text: This hotel was absolutely amazing!!! The service and staff was top tier. Rooms and property was incredible. Will definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: TBex Flyer
reviews.text:
Service needs improvement but the bed - amazing! Little disappointed with wait times at Cafe but beautiful property.  Seems like a new hotel that needs a little refinement on service and attention to detail.

Wolf was outstanding!

Price was very high considering some of the issues during our stay.

Once the detail improves, convenient location.

reviews.author: Raisa Ramos
reviews.text: We loved this hotel, the only we missed was a hot tub. The costumer service was excelente. Our housekeeping Verónica González was very attentive and did a wonderful job. We want to mention too to Alex, the houseman, was very helpful. In the front desk Ana and Emilio were helpful too. Yadira was very nice too. The guys that help us with the transportation  in the town were wonderful too. In general the staff was incredible.

reviews.author: steve g
reviews.text: Terrible service and an expensive room . I travel quite a bit and will not be going back. Front desk was rude simple as that , when im spending $500 a night i expect better. They should take a page from Ritz-Carlton,  they are the best. If you are going to charge like a luxury hotel, you should act like one....

reviews.author: R B
reviews.text: The staff at this place is so kind and friendly. I was so impressed at how welcomed I felt as a Diamond member. The front desk staff were fantastic. Housekeeping was also just as awesome. Room was clean and cozy. Beds and bedding comfortable. I do wish the sink would have functioned better but that was a minor issue. Restaurant choices are good, gym was fine, and good location. Will stay there again.

reviews.author: Yoselin Hernandez
reviews.text: Amazing

reviews.author: Ability Home Inspections
reviews.text: Didn't stay. Looks amazing. Wolf dinner

reviews.author: Azadeh Bordbar
reviews.text:
I’m from Canada and had booked this hotel for my New Year vacation. Unfortunately, my flight was canceled due to severe weather conditions. I paid for a second flight, which also ended up getting canceled.

Despite the circumstances being completely out of my control, the hotel refused to issue any refund, stating that “it’s their policy,” regardless of the reason for cancellation.

In contrast, I had also purchased a non-refundable ticket for the NYE party at the Grand Hyatt Scottsdale. Once they found out about my situation, they refunded me the full amount , no questions asked.

This has been a very disappointing customer experience with this hotel, especially compared to how other venues handled the same situation with much more empathy and flexibility.

reviews.author: ToofDocta
reviews.text:
What a surprise find. I found this hotel after I had already booked a reservation at Ocean 44 (high-end seafood restaurant) across the street. We came in from out of state for one night and really wanted to try a high-end seafood place. This hotel is literally walking distance to the restaurant so I thought I look into them. I was shocked to see that they only have a 4.1 score overall on Google and read some of the negative reviews.

Most complaints were directed to the “services” visitors had received. Usually, I tend to stay away from any businesses with Google review scores under 4.5, but because this hotel was so darn close to our restaurant and new looking, I decided to judge this book by my own experiences.

WOW, am I glad that gave this place a chance and my family and I loved it. First, check-in isn’t until 4 PM, that is true BUT Jasmine was able to set us up with an available room so we can check in earlier. She was helpful, communicative, warm & professional. Secondly, we were very impressed with the ambiance & decor of the hotel and our room. We’ve been to lot of high-end 5-star resorts and hotel all over the world. This place just makes you feel you’re RICH and FAMOUS. Modern, fancy, and very comfortable. Location is amazing, walks away from the popular Fashion Square Mall and many nearby cool fancy restaurants. Since we were out-of-towners and we didn’t rent a car, this hotel provides complimentary cart-ride services to the nearby places within a 2-mile radius. Everyone we had to deal with were professional and helpful.

Love this place, will be back in the summer months so we can enjoy the rooftop luxury pool. Be ready to be WOWed from your first step on to their front door! A+ and great job Jasmine for being there for us.

reviews.author: Kyla Couch
reviews.text: Great location next to the mall and old town. Hotel lobby is nicely decorated and smells great! Staff was very friendly. Our room was nice and the bed was very comfortable! My only slight annoyance was the hot water in the shower takes a long time to heat up, but it wasn’t that big of a deal. 10/10 would stay here again!

reviews.author: J L
reviews.text: The only hotel I stay in when i come to Scottsdale every summer. Cant beat the luxury or the views. Also has a nice gym when you want to decompress. Also its very quiet here and very peaceful. I recommend getting a balcony suite if you ever stay here.

reviews.text:
My first time staying at Caesars and I’ll definitely be back! My partner and I travel to Phoenix monthly for our daughter’s doctors appointment and this will now be my go to hotel.

Pictures does not do these hotel rooms justice! Checking in was a breeze! Also, was able to grab a last minute reservation at one of their restaurants Luna.

They also have a text feature now, so I don’t have to call down to the front desk if I have a question. Replies in mins 1000/10

reviews.author: Marianne Laupp
reviews.text: Hotel and rooms are beautiful. Service is quick and helpful. Friendly staff great restaurants and 30 steps from Fashion Square shopping. What else could you want? Perfect!!

reviews.author: Andrea Roberts
reviews.text:
We just got married at Caesars Republic in November 2025 and I truly could not have imagined a more perfect day in a more perfect venue. The entire hotel is so modern, elevated, clean, and chic — it’s truly unlike anything else in Scottsdale. We were the second wedding to have ever booked at Caesars Republic, signing back in December of 2023 before the hotel was even open. The veranda offered the most stunning view of Camelback, and with the venue being absolutely beautiful even while it was still under construction, I knew it would be out of this world once it was complete. I am happy to say that the space FAR exceeded my expectations!

I am overwhelmed by the beauty of Caesars Republic, but more importantly, the service and care of the entire team. Hannah and Charity were truly a dream to work with. They made us feel like our wedding was the top priority every step of the way, and that level of care is something I’ll never forget.

And the food!!! I’ve eaten at Luna before and already knew it was incredible, but the catering for our wedding was on another level. Our guests are still talking about it (my mouth is watering typing this). It did not feel like the typical “wedding food” at all, rather like each and every one of us were dining at a high-end restaurant.

Every single team member we interacted with was wonderful, from housekeeping to valet to the front desk. Everyone was so kind and helpful, and it just made the whole experience feel elevated. I also wish I could bottle up the scent in the lobby and the hotel itself. (If you know you know!) Finally, the bed was hands-down the comfiest bed I’ve ever slept in.

Truly, I cannot recommend Caesars Republic enough. It was beautiful, elegant, and literally unforgettable. I will dream about our wedding forever, and I would absolutely choose this venue all over again.

reviews.author: justine hurry
reviews.text: We just had an event on the roof top this past week and it was amazing! The Christmas trees and pretty lights made our event so festive!!! The food and drinks were delicious and the staff was so helpful and friendly. So grateful for them!!

reviews.author: Amy Ross
reviews.text: I co hosted an event at this hotel and it was fantastic!  The staff, food, ambience and attention to detail was top notch!  I would highly recommend this for a fun venue for a private event.  We had the outdoor veranda and the views of the city were spectacular!

reviews.author: georgina ramirez
reviews.text: The experience with the hotel and staff was very pleasant; even though we had a bad experience with Booking.com, they resolved the issue. Jasmine was a great help in making it happen. We would definitely stay here again. Thank you for your attention.

reviews.author: Dan Huff
reviews.text: Our stay could not have been better. This hotel is classy, clean, new with beautiful decor from the lobby, public seating areas, restaurants, halls, elevators and rooms. We only had one appetizer (crab arancini) but it was delicious. The room was beautiful and bed was perfect for us. We will definitely return.

reviews.author: jdpards
reviews.text: Location is great for all things Scottsdale. Rooms are very nice. The service from the staff is as good as it gets.

reviews.author: Chenise Powell
reviews.text: There are so many negative experiences to share about this hotel, it’s insane. Michael V.’s Review is spot on! This hotel is a facade— the room layouts, modern decor and views is what will capture the eye, but that staff !? TERRIBLE. As much as you may not think staff matters with a stay— IT DOES. I would encourage you to spend your money else where, where you will be valued. I visited scottsdale for the first time & I stayed at this hotel in late July, for 4 days. I arrived at about 9am. The concierge Jasmine checked me in and I payed my room incidental deposit of $600. I wasn’t able to get in a room until 3:53pm. Yes, check in is at 4pm however I have been to many hotels that allowed for an earlier check in time and I saw other guest come in after me that were checked in and given room keys. I discussed my sightings with Jasmine and she told me that the guest who have suites would be accommodated  quicker bc they are available. I took it upon myself to ask guest what type of rooms they were staying in and all of them told me regular one bedrooms. Jasmine was passive, sarcastic and unaccommodating to the point the manager Jet allowed us to receive a complementary suite. Which I really didn't care for bc the room I booked came with a Mountain View and I was not able to have that with a suite. (I was initially promised a room on the 8th floor overlooking the pool, they sent me to a room on the 3rd floor facing a building) The suite was DUSTY. I was also told that check in was taking long bc the cleaning staff was working on the floor my room was on. A whopping 6 hours later I guess they were done with 1 floor. The lies that were told to me from the very beginning that I haven’t even stated bc then I’d be writing a dissertation at that point, were extremely frustrating to the point it makes you want to slap some sense into these ppl. When you’re spending an absurd amount of money you want to be treated with respect, honesty & transparency. This staff failed. There is another review from someone in this comment section  about the hotel being 40% occupied, I was told something similar by the valet, that barely anyone was there & ppl just go there for patio drinks & the pool area. Calling down to concierge was a disappointment as well. It’s $10 a day to use the microwave fyi… I forgot a toothbrush so I needed one for the day & I thought “hotels should have little flimsy toothbrushes available” in which they did, I would just have to go down to the front desk to retrieve it bc housekeeping wasn’t available, that blew my mind bc am I in a college dorm ?? The hotel staff also messages you to check in on your stay, I didn’t even waste my time to complain bc they will just deny, deny deny . This place needs to be taken out of business or an experience hospitality staff needs to quickly take over. DO NOT RECOMMEND.

So I'm a no on ever going back, The Scott down the way is simply a way better hotel for the same 750 a night, and I hope the hotel team can turn the place around.

reviews.author: Zoe Hill
reviews.text: Stayed here for our first visit to Scottsdale & it was phenomenal! The location was perfect - close to the mall, old town & quick drive to hiking! Enjoyed the food and amazing mountain views. Found Wild Bunch Desert Guides to take me on a guided hike while in Scottsdale (& they will even pick you at Caesars). All around incredible atmosphere at this hotel - luxury rooms & food in a crazy good location. Couldn’t have asked for a better location for our first trip to Scottsdale because it was convenient to everything we wanted to do!

reviews.author: Michael Vucekovich
reviews.text:
“A Five-Star Façade for a Two-Star Motel”

Caesars Republic Scottsdale (Hilton Curio Collection)
Stayed October 17–27, 2025

The Caesars Republic Scottsdale is a new property hiding a management culture in full collapse. It’s a Hilton-branded hotel that seems to operate without systems, training, or even basic supervision — a masterclass in managerial delusion.
My family stayed for ten nights across two rooms, booking through American Express Travel for the $125 resort credit and late-checkout perks. We also paid over $600 for an extra room on our final day to ensure afternoon use before our flight to London. Despite being told late checkout was impossible, a valet later mentioned the hotel was less than 40% occupied on our departure day.
We had stayed here once before, in August 2024, when it was newly opened. Air-conditioning failed in 110-degree heat, housekeeping couldn’t supply towels, and rooms had no coffee machines. We blamed the chaos on growing pains. When Hilton assumed management, we expected improvement. That was our mistake.
The problems began immediately. Empty shampoo bottles, one roll of tissue, visible dust. Calls to housekeeping went unanswered; supplies arrived hours late or not at all. By day two, we learned to phone before leaving the room at 1 p.m. and to hope someone appeared by evening. When they did, it was cursory — they didn’t even have a working vacuum. The rooms were never actually cleaned, just rearranged.
On October 19th, the toilet broke. It was repaired but the room left filthy, and again untouched by housekeeping. Front Office Manager Jed apologized and promised our destination fees would be removed at checkout. They weren’t.
As the week went on, service collapsed entirely. Phones rang unanswered. On October 26th, the charade reached its absurd climax. I went to the desk and spoke with Tierra, the manager on duty. She consulted her computer and announced that our rooms were, in fact, spotless — she had personally checked them that morning, and any disorder must have been caused by us. When I suggested she accompany me upstairs to see for herself, she refused. When I insisted she was mistaken, she called me a liar. I raised my middle finger. Moments later, she called security. Jay, the hotel guard — reportedly in a romantic relationship with Tierra — arrived and told me I had “disrespected her.” It was a surreal moment: a guest questioning poor service confronted by a display of personal theatrics in the hotel lobby.
After my encounter, my wife returned to the hotel and picked up where I left off. She told Tierra it was impossible she had viewed the rooms and requested the housekeeping manager. She was told he was “busy.” She said she would wait. Eventually, Paul, the manager, arrived and accompanied her upstairs. He immediately apologized, acknowledging that the rooms had never been attended to.
Even other employees seemed exhausted by the dysfunction. One valet said he avoids one area at the front when the wind carries the smell of garbage from the bins. Another said a drunken guest vomited at the entrance over the weekend — it took housekeeping four hours to clean.
By checkout (handled by my wife, since I was no longer welcome at the desk), the bill still included some destination fees and only one of the two AmEx resort credits.
To be clear, the building itself is nice — new, modern, well-designed. But management has turned it into an operational farce. Staff are defensive, untrained, and apparently unsupported. Hilton’s oversight is invisible.
If this were Russia, it might make tragic sense: a shiny façade masking institutional rot. In Europe, it would be laughed at. But in Scottsdale, Arizona — I suppose I should come to expect it.
Ten nights, two rooms, roughly $15,000 later, one truth remains: this isn’t a luxury hotel. It’s a tale about what happens when incompetence replaces service and a brand name replaces accountability.

reviews.author: Cynthia Sassi
reviews.text: This is one of my favorite places to stay in Scottsdale. The rooms are so nice and the location is so convenient. The views from the room and the hotel pool are incredible. You can walk to great restaurants and shopping at Fashion Square. Love the onsite dining options as well. Bonus, they are dog-friendly.

reviews.author: Paul S. Hardersen
reviews.text:
I received a tour of the hotel recently and had the opportunity to experience Caesars Republic and the services that they offer. The rooms are impeccably designed and are very stylish - both the standard guest rooms and the suites. In addition, the overall style and design of the hotel is very attractive and appealing.

There are also two pools at the property and my favorite is the outdoor pool on one of the top floors. There is also an outdoor reception area, as well as abundant meeting space for groups of various sizes. This hotel is relatively new and it shows!

Finally, the staff are very attentive and helpful. Overall, I had a wonderful visit and look forward to returning soon.

reviews.author: Season Chavez
reviews.text: Although this property is beautiful and the rooms are new and nicer, when you find the used bar of soap from the previous guest in your shower, you start to question… are the sheets clean? How many times has this towel been used? Especially after you’ve requested for your room to be cleaned and said soap removed and nothing was done after being out of our room from 9am to 11pm only to return for 30 min at 2pm to again request the room to be cleaned and no “DND” sign on the door. Then you go to eat breakfast in the only breakfast place in the hotel to be told repeatedly that every item on the menu you’d like to order is not available and then find out “the chef didn’t come to work this morning so you can find something across the street at the mall” - valet complains that “he’s the only one here”, and the lady that checks you in looks stoned and had her belly hanging over the top of her jeans that wouldn’t stay pulled up.  Such a sloppy experience with so many opportunities to do better and at every experience it just keeps getting worse. Don’t spend your money here when there are so many better options in Scottsdale.

reviews.author: Alfonso Johnson
reviews.text:
Caesars Republic Scottsdale, a Hilton Hotel, is the perfect blend of modern luxury and vibrant Arizona charm. 🌴 From the moment you arrive, the hotel’s sleek design, elegant interiors, and welcoming staff make you feel like royalty. The atmosphere is both sophisticated and lively, offering a true resort experience in the heart of Scottsdale.

The pool area is absolutely stunning — surrounded by palm trees, stylish cabanas, and refreshing vibes, it’s the perfect spot to relax under the sun or enjoy a cocktail by the water. 🍹 The rooms are spacious, beautifully designed, and feature top-notch amenities that ensure comfort and class.

Dining at Caesars Republic is another highlight. The on-site restaurants serve exceptional dishes crafted with care, blending local flavors and international flair. The rooftop bar offers breathtaking views of Camelback Mountain, especially at sunset — a must-see moment! 🌅

Whether you’re visiting for business, a romantic getaway, or a weekend escape, this hotel exceeds expectations in every way. Impeccable service, modern luxury, and an unforgettable atmosphere make Caesars Republic Scottsdale a truly remarkable destination. ✨🏨

reviews.author: Taylor Stone
reviews.text:
I want to start by sharing that the hotel itself is beautiful. Great location and also the restaurant Luna had great food and amazing staff/bartenders. That said, the front desk was pretty awful. They seemed to be very uneducated of the property and it was very obvious they didn’t want to be there. We probably interacted with 5-6 different front desk agents because we wanted to upgrade to a different room and they made us very aware they were annoyed and made us feel like we were an inconvenience.

We are local and would have loved to do more staycations here but will more than likely go somewhere else.

reviews.author: Kristina R
reviews.text: Beautiful rooms and incredibly comfortable beds. Small mix uo with my paid late checkout but the young lady on Thursday morning was quick to accommodate. Hotel is literally across from the mall with ample shopping and dining options. Will look for this hotel again when back in Scottsdale.

reviews.author: Nicole Foster
reviews.text:
great hotel nice rooms  good location mall is right across the road .
It  was my birthday week so they surprise me with a nice little cake in my room that just make my day more  gladly appreciate 👍🏾

reviews.author: Chris B
reviews.text: Stayed here on a Tuesday and there was construction going on so you can hear banging and drilling. The pool amenities were not available the up stairs was closed and downstairs pool had no pool bar service. I had to buy a resort pass to the W hotel to get away from the chaos. I returned and there was a hotel convention happening with tons of loud people mingling all over. I ordered room service and after close to two hours later  of waiting I called to cancel the order which was a salad and soda. I left because I couldn’t enjoy dinner at any of the restaurants there with all the people from conference. I came back to be awaken by loud music coming from another room it was after midnight, I called concierge and they said they would send security. After 1am it still continued called concierge again and nothing was done. Didn’t get any sleep and when checking out the front desk person didn’t ask how the stay was or anything. I brought up that I had an awful experience and she didn’t care. I noticed they had a flyer that stated there was going to be construction going on and I told her this sort of thing should’ve been brought up in an email in advance other wise I would’ve went somewhere else. Would not recommend at all, horrible experience nothing luxury about it.

reviews.author: Becki Agnew
reviews.text:
Disappointing. Caesars Republic is not a place. I will recommend the one positive is the location. It’s close to the mall when you first pull in the parking lot in and around the hotel is not for the guest of the hotel. It is for the restaurants within it. The parking for the hotel is across the street and under the hotel they clearly do not value their guest starting from here. The layout of the room was spectacular. We had a beautiful view however for a new hotel the water pressure is nonexistent. It literally does not come out of the showerhead past the drain, which is just below it. I notified the front desk and received no feedback. There were no complementary soaps or toiletries . There were two guest and only one robe provided again. The front desk was notified and no response at for a new hotel. The beds are extremely uncomfortable. I’m not a big person and each time I moved it made noise and each side black support the support was in the middle of the bed. This tells me the hotel will never have comfortable beds.  The pillows reeked of cigarette smoke. This was actually addressed, and the pillows were changed out at that time. They also must’ve noticed there was no complementary soaps on toiletries at which time housekeeping left. The rooms are not very soundproof, People’s voices in the hallway could be heard throughout the night and the sound of construction was ongoing  i’m extremely disappointed. The hotel hallway leading to our room, apparently has not seen a vacuum in quite some time. I’m not exaggerating if this is a floor that conventions are held on, and they need to vacuum the floors due to the traffic.
I do not expect anything free but acknowledgment would have been polite. The only thing exceptional of this hotel is the Window views if you want to sacrifice Comfort and simplicity, then this is your hotel

reviews.author: Mike W
reviews.text:
Yet another disappointment in this part of the world. Why is it that the hotels here are so poor?

It is almost as if it is an accepted standard…it is beyond my comprehension.

No water in rooms…even with the two bottles with Hilton membership. Had to go and get them from reception. No room service…so don’t check in after 10:30pm!!!

Nothing in the area either and no recommendations or suggestions.

No ironing board.

Curtains didn’t work.

Nothing good to say so far.

The bed linens are not changed daily even though the room rate is the same. Why push your social responsibility onto the paying customer when we all know it is about cost savings, not your environmental awareness?

The first hotel in Scottsdale/Phoenix that actually provides good service will get all my business…so far, all are below average.

reviews.author: Terrell Maxey
reviews.text: Best in class

reviews.author: S P
reviews.text: We wanted to watch the sunset from the rooftop but it was being maintained that day.  But on our way out, we noticed live music in the lobby.  It was a Friday.  We stopped a manager who gave us more information and offered us a seat on the comfortable couches and we ended up eating there.  The service from every single member of staff we came into contact with, was simply, superb! Of course the food was good.  The music was enjoyable and the highlight of our evening.  Kailee/Kaylee took great care of us and her attention to detail was immaculate.  Highly recommend this hotel even for us locals, we will be back!
